name: french-name-sort
title: French alphabetical order
prompt:
`sort_names(names)` in `names.py` must sort names the way a French class list is ordered:
- comparison ignores letter case, accents (é, è, ê, ç, ï, ô...) and surrounding spaces
- ligatures compare as two letters: œ = oe, æ = ae
- if two names are equal under those rules, the one with FEWER accented letters comes first;
  if still equal, keep the input order
- return the original strings (unchanged) in a new list
